answer: Because your offer was issued on January 28, before February 1, 2026, it keeps the original terms of 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever comes first, rather than the newer 5-day limit. Seven days from January 28 is February 4, and we honor the offer if your appraisal appointment is on or before the expiration date, as long as you haven't driven more than 300 additional miles. Please confirm the exact expiration date on your offer page or in your confirmation email. If the offer does expire, you can request a new one at any time, though the amount reflects current market prices and may be higher or lower.
